fields.value: ADiDeNano - Atmospheric Dispersion and Deposition of Nanoparticles

dsDescriptionValue.value: ADiDeNano simulation model source code (Version 1.0) for atmospheric dispersion and deposition of aerosol nanoparticles. The simulation model was generated by Mikko Poikkimäki at Finnish Institute of Occupational Health and Tampere University, Finland. Documentation and examples of use are reported in a scientific publication: Poikkimäki et al. (2022), Local Scale Exposure and Fate of Engineered Nanomaterials, Toxics. The most recent version of the source code is available at https://gitlab.com/MiPo/ADiDeNano. The source code is based on Python (3.7) programming language.
